column1: # Nouns that numbers agree with: units, money, nouns that take an ordinal and nouns whose ending does not tell
# their gender. One noun per line, tab-separated columns:
#   2. use: "-"; "label" - a number after it is its name, in the nominative ("лампа 2", "у лампы 2"); "plural" - no
#      singular, the singular columns repeat the plural ("сутки": "одн+и сутки", "дв+ое суток"); "time" - after "в" the
#      accusative ("в сред+у"); "ordinal" - a number before the singular reads as an ordinal ("на 5 этаже"); "year" - the same, but
#      only in the oblique cases ("в 2025 году", but "21 год"); "money:<noun>" - a currency whose hundredth is <noun>;
#   5. optional: the form after 2, 3 and 4 when it is not the genitive singular ("два час+а").
# A masculine noun whose accusative singular is its genitive is animate ("гость": "встретил одног+о гостя").
# A form may give alternatives after '/': the first one is spoken, all of them are recognized. '+' stands before the
# stressed vowel; words of one syllable and words stressed on 'ё' have none.
